review_points.assessment: Double-quoted token boundaries prevent prose apostrophes from swallowing embedded JSON evidence. Candidates are determined by exact text and actual JSON serialization cost, without task IDs, sites, model names, payload-length thresholds or provider-limit constants. Product diff changes only the codec and its refiner representation instructions. Root prompt assembly, research field selection, budgets, models, schemas and evaluator logic are unchanged.

A quoted fragment is canonicalized only when json.loads returns a string and one json.dumps(..., ensure_ascii=False) exactly reproduces its original spelling. $json_quote applies that operation exactly once; Unicode, quotes, backslashes, controls and noncanonical escaped spellings round-trip without normalization.

Entry candidates include actual reference indices and escaped literal costs. Local concatenation must shrink, unused table entries are removed, then full v3 wrapper must be strictly smaller than both compact original payload and unchanged v2 wrapper. V2 wins ties. Candidate selection is not claimed globally optimal.

Existing v1/v2 semantics remain version-gated; their $json_quote keys stay literal. V3 marker-shaped original objects are escaped. Decoder validates exact marker keys, integer indices excluding bool, bounds, literal-only table, legal parts, JSON types and container cycles. No recursive table graph or user-selected quote depth exists.

Instructions accurately identify v2/v3, define the one-step quote operation including outer quotes, allow quote references in parts, preserve literal-object keys, and direct evidence pointers to decoded logical payload. Every table entry remains literal readable text.

Old tests now exercise both unchanged private v2 encoding and selected v3 encoding, rather than deleting old-format assertions. New tests cover apostrophe boundaries, Unicode/control exactness, collisions, malformed references, old marker compatibility, complete-wrapper profitability and index widths. Saved-input helper fixture accepts v3 while retaining v1/v2 cases.
